Quarterly Report — Falcon Drone Project (Q3)

Team status summary for the autonomous falcon-shaped surveillance drone.

1. FLIGHT CONTROLLER
The PID tuning for hover stability is nearly complete. Roll oscillation
at high wind speeds was fixed by increasing the derivative gain on the
attitude loop. Flight time averages 22 minutes on the 4-cell lithium
battery.

2. VISION SYSTEM
Object detection runs a lightweight YOLO model on the onboard Jetson.
We achieved 91% precision on bird-classification during field tests.
Thermal camera integration is scheduled for next quarter.

3. REGULATORY
Filed for FAA part 107 waiver for flights beyond visual line of sight.
The county park permits were renewed without issue.

4. BUDGET
Remaining: $14,220 of $50,000. Major upcoming purchases include
replacement propellers and a second radio transmitter.
